pre_registration_exposure: User proposal, current primary literature, public artifact schemas and aggregate class counts were inspected. No scorer has been fitted or scored under this study. No human audit has occurred. This registration cannot retroactively make the supplied draft preregistered.
primary_risk: P(suppress alert | alert is a true attack)
guarantee: Per frozen scorer/predicate certificate: with probability at least1-delta over IID attack calibration units, population attack-suppression risk is at most alpha. A temporal/adversarial shift is outside this theorem.
calibration_method: One-sided binomial order-statistic tolerance bound; maximum r with BinomCDF(r,n,alpha)<=delta; strict greater-than suppression above ascending order statistic n-r
effective_score: Frozen benignness score on eligible examples, negative infinity otherwise; n counts all attack calibration units, not only eligible attacks
multiplicity: No simultaneous guarantee or best-of-scorers selection claim without a prospective delta allocation or fresh independent calibration after selection

hypotheses_retained_for_future_release.H2: At least20% non-attack alert suppression and lower95% group-aware CI above10%, on at leasttwo qualified datasets; useful suppression is not guaranteed
hypotheses_retained_for_future_release.H1: Evaluate population-risk uncertainty and explicitly account for finite test uncertainty; a test fraction abovealpha is not automatically certificate failure
hypotheses_retained_for_future_release.H3: Pending qualified attacker-controlled fields and a new pre-efficacy registration; no zero-denominator ratios or claimed arbitrary-shift certification

g0_dataset_requirements: sufficient attack calibration and evaluation support

g0_predicates.P1: Trusted independent raw-event reference and exact agreement on host/user/rule/time; a copy of the same processed row is not independent evidence
g0_predicates.P2: Known noncritical severity and frozen eligible rule-class list; missing severity/list membership is not eligible
g0_predicates.P3: Explicit complete incident-context lookup says unclustered at decision time; missing cluster data is not a no-cluster result
g0_predicates.P4: Required fields are present and correctly typed

synthetic_qualification.score_distribution: IID continuous Uniform(0,1) attack benignness; exact population tail known
synthetic_qualification.monte_carlo_comparison: Report true population-risk violation frequency and exact binomial upper limit separately from finite-test fluctuations; simulations verify software, not cybersecurity effectiveness

author_published_metrics: Reference context only until exact matched model, prompt, split, label mapping and denominator are verified; cross-paper FPR is not workload suppression
